clues: This town sits at the south end of a great bay, in the heart of a famed tech vale.
Most of the rain here falls in the cold months. The warm months are dry, with next to no rain at all.
Men from Spain set up a mission here in 1777. The town grew from that first camp of faith.
The most old school of high learning in its state stands here. It draws crowds of youth to this tech town.
A huge sports ground here hosts a famed pro foot team. The team bears the name of the big town up the bay.
